command: cd /code && mkdir -p /results && (Rscript calibration_error.R > /results/calibration_error.out 2>&1; echo CAL1:$?; Rscript lss1_summary_analyses.R > /results/lss1_summary_analyses.out 2>&1; echo LSS1:$?; Rscript lss2_summary_analyses.R > /results/lss2_summary_analyses.out 2>&1; echo LSS2S:$?; Rscript lss2_peak_analyses.R > /results/lss2_peak_analyses.out 2>&1; echo LSS2P:$?) > /results/run_status.txt 2>&1; cat /results/run_status.txt; for f in /results/*.out; do echo '---' $f; sed -n '1,120p' $f; done
